question: Pectin, which is responsible for the firmness and softness of fruits, is mainly composed of which acid unit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Galacturonic acid.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pectin **is a **complex carbohydrate** that is found in the** cell walls of plants **and is responsible for the **firmness and softness of fruits.**
 
• The main acid unit that makes up pectin is** galacturonic acid,** which is a** sugar acid **that is derived from **glucose.**
 
• Pectin is made up of **complex polysaccharides,** which are widely distributed in the **green parts of terrestrial plants** and found in the primary cell walls of plants.
 
• The main element of the **middle lamella,** where pectin binds cells, is pectin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aspartic acid** is an **amino acid** that is not found in pectin**, **but is found in **proteins.**

 
 
• **Lentils, soybeans, garbanzo beans**, and other** legumes **are plant sources of aspartic acid. 
 
 
 
• **Lactic acid** is a** simple organic acid** that is produced by bacteria during** fermentation** and is not found in pectin.
 
 
• Our body creates lactic acid when our cells** digest carbohydrates** for energy.
 
 
 
• **Glutamic acid** is an** amino acid t**hat is not found in pectin, but is found in **proteins.**
 
 
• It transforms into** glutamate **inside the body.
 
• This substance aids in the transmission and reception of information between** brain nerve cells.**​
